From the relief prayed for by the petitioner, it has emerged that essentially the applicant has prayed for fixing the date for final hearing of the petition.

3. So as far as said request is concerned, the petition was already listed for final hearing on 24.11.2015 (and even prior to that date it was being listed for final hearing), however, on account of leave note by learned advocate for the HC-NIC Page 6 of 8 Created On Tue Dec 01 01:56:24 IST 2015 respondents, the petition had to adjourned and consequently it was adjourned to today.
4. Today also, the petition is listed in the cause list for final hearing and separate order is passed in the petition.
5. Since the matter is already listed in the cause list for final hearing, any other or separate order is not required to be passed for the said purpose.
6. In view of the said fact, the request made in this application stands granted.
7. So far other requests which are prayed for by the applicant in present application are concerned,
the said requests and reliefs can be considered in main petition and not by way of civil application.

8. The other requests made in the Civil HC-NIC Page 7 of 8 Created On Tue Dec 01 01:56:24 IST 2015 Application will be treated as part of and will be decided, after hearing the parties, in main petition and for that purpose, office is directed to place the papers of Civil Application along with Dineshkumar Mohanlal Sheth vs Vadodara Municipal Corpn. @ Vadodara ...
